info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Banking Gap Analysis Review Submission API
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of reviews pertaining to gap analyses in banking models. Users can submit detailed feedback or evaluations based on their findings, which helps in enhancing decision-making and model accuracy. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, banking professionals, and developers working on financial modeling tools. By facilitating comprehensive reviews, organizations can ensure continuous improvement and alignment of their banking strategies.

post.summary: Create a Review for Gap Analysis Model
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the specified gap analysis model identified by RES-100045. It enables the user to provide feedback or ratings based on their analysis, contributing to the overall evaluation of the model's effectiveness.
